description: ACS 2020-2024 5-year detailed tables via the Census Data API: 17 full tables (population, age/sex, income, poverty, education, employment, commuting, housing, industry, occupation) for all counties and 38 key estimates for all census tracts, with margins of error

source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey
source.license_notes: US federal government work: public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105); no redistribution restriction; cite the publisher. Census API terms: key required for volume use; do not imply Census endorsement. Estimates are survey-based period estimates (2020-2024) with 90% margins of error; not comparable to overlapping 5-year periods.
